name: suede-sync-packaging
description: Suede AI skill that prepares a song for sync pitching: scene and emotional angles, a supervisor-facing one-sheet, an exists/missing/unknown asset checklist covering master, instrumental, clean, and stems, screened lyric flags, mood tags, AI-involvement disclosure, and the open clearance questions kept in their own labeled pile. author: JasonColapietro
